items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Harry Fagmitude and I... they used to call two banjo players bumping at each other... Harry would take a solo... then the next number they would play would be for me to take a solo.

ctx.x: Think about how old you were, how old were you getting that way?

It must have been around in the, World War I. My daddy wasn't old enough to go to, no, my daddy had, I think it was 18 to 45, that, in World War I, they were taken from 18 to 45. Where Cal was too young, and my daddy was about a year or two years too old. So, it was around 50, they could stop. Right, mm-hmm. And so, that made my daddy, my daddy was too old, and Cal was too young. Oh, but Cal, he was anxious to go, he wanted to get out there. He didn't know what he was going to do out there anyway, but he wanted…
I think you remember these names so well.
